title: Circuit subtraction construction
statement: Given two algebraic circuits $C$ and $C'$ on the same number of inputs, form a circuit by listing the gates of $C$, then the gates of $C'$ with their node references shifted by the size of $C$, and then a subtraction gate whose inputs are the last nodes of these two circuits, at indices $|C|-1$ and $|C|+|C'|-1$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: Both circuits have the same number of inputs
